checkerboard_points — CALIB checkerboard op

• 資料種類:無 → keypoints(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.checkerboard_points(pattern_size, square_size)(要直接呼叫實作,import calib_lm; calib_lm.checkerboard_points(pattern_size, square_size);從台帳取用則 opscalib.get("checkerboard_points"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

依列優先順序回傳棋盤格內角點的板座標 (x, y)(keypoints)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Board coordinates (x, y) of the inner corners of a checkerboard with pattern_size = (cols, rows) inner corners and squares of square_size (mm), row-major: index r·cols + c is (c·square, r·square). The first corner is the origin (OpenCV's convention for findChessboardCorners). The board has (cols + 1) x (rows + 1) squares.

Raises ValueError: cols・rows が 2 未満・整数でない、square_size が正でない。
